_comment: Which pieces of the Kenney roguelike character sheet make up each character. Coordinates are (column, row) on art-source/kenney/roguelike-characters/Spritesheet/roguelikeChar_transparent.png, a 16px grid with a 1px gutter. Render a labelled index of the sheet with: python.exe C:\temp\_script\officerchoi-char-grid.py
_layer_order: Layers are drawn in the order listed. body first, then clothing, then hair on top.
